film.title: MIDnight Weave: She's Over There (Pilot)
film.description:
The first MIDnight Weave, the Mid-Majors tonight. Eastern Kentucky, a 9.5-point underdog, beat Kent State 65-49. UTEP beat Florida A&M 79-46. Lacey Combs breaks down how EKU out-thought Kent, Mateo Sandoval takes the UTEP win personally, Aunt Brenda calls in from Richmond, and the host keeps looking the wrong way.

Hosted by Matthew Hagan. Lacey Combs and Mateo Sandoval are fictional AI anchors with AI voices and are not affiliated with any school. The host is real. The lead-in music is original.

The Mid-Majors tonight. See more at https://hardwoodbricks.com
